delivery_target: Future callers of valid_table_capsD that hold cte_wp_at and valid_table_caps but lack an explicit cap_asid = None hypothesis
new_lemma:
lemma valid_table_capsD_no_asid_hyp:
  "\<lbrakk> cte_wp_at ((=) cap) ptr s; valid_table_caps s;
        is_pt_cap cap | is_pd_cap cap \<rbrakk>
        \<Longrightarrow> \<forall>r \<in> obj_refs cap. obj_at (empty_table (set (second_level_tables (arch_state s)))) r s"
  apply (clarsimp simp: cte_wp_at_caps_of_state valid_table_caps_def)
  apply (cases ptr, fastforce)
  done
rationale: The scanner noted cap_asid head never appears in the proof body text. valid_table_caps_def internally quantifies over cap_asid conditions; if clarsimp/fastforce can satisfy the instantiation without an explicit cap_asid cap = None hypothesis in the lemma statement (relying instead on valid_table_caps to supply it), the premise is droppable. Proof body copied verbatim; trial decides.
strengthening_claim: (cte_wp_at ((=) cap) ptr s \<and> valid_table_caps s \<and> (is_pt_cap cap | is_pd_cap cap)) ==> (cte_wp_at ((=) cap) ptr s \<and> valid_table_caps s \<and> (is_pt_cap cap | is_pd_cap cap) \<and> cap_asid cap = None)
